title: trace impact
description: Cartographer output at <bundle-dir>/impact.json. Reports the rebuild blast radius for every affected attr_path in a finding: reverse closure count, closure bucket (matching the eval corpus axis values), sample, and which downstreams the graph has flagged as critical. No policy decisions beyond reporting the `exceeds_threshold` fact; Steward decides what that fact means for bundle.kind (see rule §6 gate 4).

threshold_policy.description: Name of the threshold policy applied, for replay. v0 default: 'v0-default' (500 reverse-closure derivations).

affected_attr_paths.description: Summary: every attr_path analyzed. Mirrors per_attr[].attr_path.

reverse_closure_count.description: Union-count of distinct attrs in the reverse closure across all affected_attr_paths. Deduplicated.

reverse_closure_sample.description: Up to N representative attrs from the union reverse closure. N is a Cartographer implementation detail; treat as informational. Not used for policy.

critical_downstreams.description: Union of attrs flagged as critical across all affected_attr_paths. Used by Steward only to display; does not gate auto-merge in v0.

per_attr.description: Per-attr breakdown. One entry per attr_path in affected_attr_paths.

analysis_status.description: Honest reporting of whether reverse-closure analysis ran end-to-end. 'complete' means the graph backend produced real reverse_closure_count + critical_downstreams data. Anything else (e.g. 'skipped-v0') means downstream consumers MUST treat the closure data as advisory only; Steward routes such impacts to human-review-required.

analysis_reason.description: Free-text explanation when analysis_status != 'complete'. Helps the human reviewer (and future migrations) know what was missing.
